name: Botanic1
description: Genomic language models for land plants

paragraphs: Static landing page for the Botanic1 models (Living Models), linking to the model cards and technical report. Pages:

links, organised in three tabs. The landing page uses assets/landing.css and assets/landing.js; all sections remain readable without JavaScript. A future SAE tab can be added with a tab link and matching section, without changing the tab controller. Setup, code examples, and model specifications stay in the model cards; the usage tab links to the relevant sections. The Overview and Models & data tabs each end with the report's reference and BibTeX entry (bioRxiv doi 10.64898/2026.09.04.749355), with a copy-to-clipboard button handled by assets/landing.js. assets/overview.js adds compact…
size and training-token views, filterable and sortable. Lines in both scatter plots connect checkpoints from the same model family in increasing model size.
